thread_title: New player, In need of advices

content:
Hello and welcome aboard <:Saya_yum:1513124263291387975> 

First off : did you find Cheri's handbook ? Just type /new if you didn't.

About time : it's really up to you. If you ficus on time-limited tasks it can all be done in under an hour per week.
The story's not going away and if you don't the events wheb they come you'll have the opportunity to spend a currency that's dedicated to this specific purpose to access them.

About teams : too early to give you advice.
The first chapters are quite forgiving so I suggest you just pick whichever awakener you and change your linup regularly ( including all 4 realms ! ).
After a short time you should know enough about the game to decide what gameplay suits you best.

You will eventually want 5 functionnal teams ( that's 19 awakeners ! ) so don't feel guilty about leaving aside that cherished mate to try others.

When you face a wall will be the time to ask for advice and tweaks on your teams. For now, you can just enjoy the show <:Saya_wow:1513124172895879198> 

And now, for the tricky part : banners.
I suggest you give it a few days before you invest but do try displayed awakeners ( you can find the trials under the "record" button from home page ).
Cheri mentions pull tiers so you could use these for reference. Just keep in mind the way you play the game is only yours and these are nothing more than generic hints.
 
Have fun <:Saya_duel:1513123467917135903>
